displayName: OCI-WSTG07-015: Buffer Overflow via HTTP Request
description:
Detects unusually long HTTP requests that may trigger buffer overflow vulnerabilities

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_wstg07_015", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%buffer%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%overflow%') AND "value" > 0
